notes.title: Pilots implemented and balance changes
notes.notes:
[b]Pilot system implemented:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can choose between the 4 pilots to control your mech. Each one has pros and cons that will affect you playthrough.
[/list]


[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Orbital weapons now deal more damage.
[*] Orbital powerups no longer appear in the same place as obstacles.
[/list]

[b]On the next patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] New maps
[/list]

Loading screen implemented.
Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Remove the lvl 10 limit on the orbitals, now you can lvl up them endlessly. Have fun
Bug fixed:
- 10% shop sale relic was not working when you locked a piece.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Endless mode unlocked after you beat the game once.
[*] 2 new achievements.
[*] Drone damage info panel implemented.
[/list]

notes.title: Pacth 1.2.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed new game error after finishing a run (if it persists, please [b]REINSTALL[/b] the game)
[*] Reduced the drop of blue coins.
[*] Numbers to obtain achievements adjusted so that it is not so easy.
[*] Number of enemies destroyed are displayed on the main screen.
[*] Waves 18, 19 and 20 adjusted to be more difficult
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.4
notes.notes:
-Coin amount gain balanced. In the later waves you gained too much.
-10 k enemies destroyed achievement fixed.

notes.title: Pacth 1.2.3
notes.notes:
-"Maximun drone" achievement updated to at least 250 000 damage with one drone type in one playthrough.
-"Somebody call for an exterminator" achievement fixed, eliminate  a total of 10 000 enemies (sum of all playthroughs)

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
-Better chance to get blue coins
-Fixed achievement of Max drone

notes.title: Pacth 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for the feedback, with that I am working to improve the game. Now I have update the following:
- New panel when entering the store for the first time explaning the number of weapons you can equip.
- New warning panel when exiting the store if you haven't used all weapon slots.
- Enemies from waves 1 and 2 give more coins and have less hp.
- Dash distance improve.

notes.title: Release now - 15% discount first week
notes.notes: Finally, Metal Ascension is release with a discount of 15% the first week.

notes.title: Demo 1.0.2
notes.notes: Thanks a lot for your feedbacks. I am happy to announce that the dash mechanic and the relics systems are implemented and you can test them now. Also there are 2 more waves so a total of 7 for you to complete.
